description: Get one public Morereply poll by its id, its page URL (https://morereply.com/poll/{id}) or a short link (https://morereply.com/p/{code}). Returns the question, options, status, dates, total votes, and per-option votes and percentages when the poll shows results to visitors. A poll set to show results after close, or after voting, returns no per-option numbers until it closes.

poll.description: Poll id (UUID), poll page URL, or morereply.com/p/ short link

name: get_poll

analyses_url.description: Page listing the poll's published analyses

language.description: ISO 639-1 language the poll is written in

id.description: Option id; pass it to vote

percent.description: Share of the poll's option votes, 0 to 100; absent while results are hidden

votes.description: Votes for this option; absent while results are hidden

results_visible.description: False when the poll hides per-option results from visitors right now

status.description: scheduled, option_collection, reviewing, voting, closed or cancelled

your_vote.description: The option the connected user voted for; absent for guests and when they have not voted

title: Get poll
